purpose: Present one CRM entity through compact facts, masked contacts, provenance and a source-labelled timeline.

accessibility.keyboard: Actions are supplied as native controls.
accessibility.focus: Tab order follows fact groups, actions and timeline.
accessibility.screenReader: Sensitive facts are masked in the model; every history item names its source.

invariants: Full contacts require permission-filtered backend values.
A timeline claim always includes source and timestamp.
No raw legacy row is rendered.
